chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from al-Ṣaffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from Samāʿah, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Do not sit in the iqʿāʾ posture between the two sajdahs.

key_terms.إِقْعَاءً: a specific manner of sitting prohibited here
key_terms.تُقْعِ: to sit in the iqʿāʾ posture

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sit in the iqʿāʾ posture between the two sajdahs in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction concerning posture in salat (prayer). It prohibits iqʿāʾ, a particular manner of sitting, between the two sajdahs, indicating proper etiquette and form in the ritual prayer.
